title: Hana Koa Brewing Company

services.name: Surf Pup
services.desc: Every year, Hana Koa Brewing Co. releases our highly anticipated Surf Pup-a sour ale beer with a mission. This isn't just a local craft brew; it’s a community-wide effort to support the doggos of Hawaii. We proudly donate 10% of all proceeds to incredible local rescue organizations, including K9 Kokua, Fur Angel Foundation, Aloha Animal Outreach, Oahu SPCA, and Alii Animal Hospital. Surf Pup is more than a beer release; it’s our biggest Honolulu based dog adoption event of the year! We transform our space into the ultimate dog-friendly festival in Kaka’ako dedicated to getting local pups adopted and raising vital funds for animal welfare.
